text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek has arrived at the Arima Kinen determined to make me the best trainer in the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All at once, the entire crowd erupts into cheers for the both of us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The stage is set for Super Creek to put everything we've trained for on the line.
